ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited declared its second interim dividend for FY2026-27, alongside announcing a significant delay in its critical ABS production capacity expansion project from September 2026 to March 2027 due to global war-related disruptions affecting equipment delivery and commissioning. Concurrently, the company reported a material decline in profitability, with Q2 FY27 Profit After Tax falling by approximately 18% year-over-year and 35% quarter-over-quarter, despite a 24% year-over-year increase in revenue, indicating significant margin pressure or rising costs.
